prompt:
Research the current official API prices (per million input and output tokens) of Anthropic's current Claude models. Cite Anthropic's own pricing page and quote the prices.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results, here are the current official API prices for Anthropic's Claude models as of October 2026. All prices are in USD per million tokens (MTok).

**Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1**
The most advanced models, Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, are priced at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Fable 5.1 | $10 / MTok | $12.50 / MTok | $20 / MTok | $0.25 / MTok1 | $50 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Fable 5.1 costs $10/MTok for input and $50/MTok for output.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Mythos 5.1 (limited availability) | $10 / MTok | $12.50 / MTok | $20 / MTok | $0.25 / MTok1 | $50 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Mythos 5.1 costs $10/MTok for input and $50/MTok for output.

**Claude Opus 5 and Opus 4.x Series**
Claude Opus 5 and the recent Opus 4.x models (4.8, 4.7, 4.6, 4.5) share the same pricing structure of $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens. Older Opus models (4.1 and 4) are retired on most platforms but retain higher pricing where available.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Opus 5 | $5 / MTok | $6.25 / MTok | $10 / MTok | $0.50 / MTok | $25 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 5 costs $5/MTok for input and $25/MTok for output.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Opus 4.8 | $5 / MTok | $6.25 / MTok | $10 / MTok | $0.50 / MTok | $25 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 4.8 costs $5/MTok for input and $25/MTok for output.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Opus 4.1 (retired, except on Bedrock and Google Cloud) | $15 / MTok | $18.75 / MTok | $30 / MTok | $1.50 / MTok | $75 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Retired Claude Opus 4.1 costs $15/MTok for input and $75/MTok for output.

**Claude Sonnet 5 and Sonnet 4.x Series**
Claude Sonnet 5 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. This pricing was initially introductory but has become standard.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "The $2/$ 10 per million input/output token pricing for Claude Sonnet 5, announced at launch as introductory pricing through August 31, 2026, is now the standard price." | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 5 standard pricing is $2/MTok input and $10/MTok output.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Sonnet 5 | $2 / MTok | $2.50 / MTok | $4 / MTok | $0.20 / MTok | $10 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 5 costs $2/MTok for input and $10/MTok for output.

Older Sonnet models (4.6, 4.5, and retired 4) are priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Sonnet 4.6 | $3 / MTok | $3.75 / MTok | $6 / MTok | $0.30 / MTok | $15 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 4.6 costs $3/MTok for input and $15/MTok for output.

**Claude Haiku 4.5 and Haiku 3.5**
Claude Haiku 4.5 is priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens. The older Haiku 3.5 is retired on most platforms but costs $0.80/$4 where available.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Haiku 4.5 | $1 / MTok | $1.25 / MTok | $2 / MTok | $0.10 / MTok | $5 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Claude Haiku 4.5 costs $1/MTok for input and $5/MTok for output.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "| Claude Haiku 3.5 (retired, except on Bedrock and Google Cloud) | $0.80 / MTok | $1 / MTok | $1.60 / MTok | $0.08 / MTok | $4 / MTok |" | CLAIM: Retired Claude Haiku 3.5 costs $0.80/MTok for input and $4/MTok for output.

**Regional and Batch Pricing Variations**
Prices may vary by region (e.g., US-only inference is slightly higher) and usage type (batch processing is discounted).
SOURCE: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/files/4zrzovbb/website/9e03129acc36d31970777d336f969bb53dc84355.pdf | QUOTE: "| Standard | US-only inference | All | $11.00 | $55.00 | $13.75 | $22.00 | $0.275 |" | CLAIM: Claude Fable 5.1 US-only inference costs $11/MTok input and $55/MTok output.
SOURCE: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/files/4zrzovbb/website/9e03129acc36d31970777d336f969bb53dc84355.pdf | QUOTE: "Batch processing Global All $5.00 $25.00 $6.25 $10.00 $0.125" | CLAIM: Claude Fable 5.1 batch processing global pricing is $5/MTok input and $25/MTok output.
